meta.name: glycoengineering
meta.description: Analyze and engineer protein glycosylation. Scan sequences for N-glycosylation sequons (N-X-S/T), predict O-glycosylation hotspots, and access curated glycoengineering tools (NetOGlyc, GlycoShield, GlycoWorkbench). For glycoprotein engineering, therapeutic antibody optimization, and vaccine design.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析蛋白质糖基化位点,辅助抗体与疫苗设计
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在做治疗性抗体或疫苗的糖基化设计。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze protein glycosylation sites to support antibody and vaccine design.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you engineer glycosylation for therapeutic antibodies or vaccines.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能分析蛋白糖基化:扫描 N-糖基化位点(N-X-S/T),预测 O-糖基化热点,并调用 NetOGlyc、GlycoShield 等工具进行糖基化工程分析,用于抗体、疫苗设计。
howto.when: 当用户提交蛋白序列,或要求抗体 Fc 优化、治疗蛋白/疫苗设计、生物类似药糖型比较等糖基化相关分析时触发。

say.text: 扫描这段序列的 N-糖基化位点
say.note: 返回所有 N-X-S/T 位点及位置。

say.text: 预测这条蛋白的 O-糖基化热点
say.note: 给出候选 S/T 位点及局部 S/T 密度分数。

say.text: 把 IgG1 Fc 的 N297 突变为 Q,消除糖基化
say.note: 将 Asn 换成 Gln,生成突变序列。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can analyze protein glycosylation: scan for N-glycosylation sequons (N-X-S/T), predict O-glycosylation hotspots, and call external tools like NetOGlyc, GlycoShield, GlycoWorkbench for glycoengineering, supporting antibody and vaccine design.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides a protein sequence, or asks for antibody Fc optimization, therapeutic protein/vaccine design, biosimilar glycan comparison, or related glycosylation analysis.

say_en.text: Scan this sequence for N-glycosylation sites.
Predict O-glycosylation hotspots for this protein.
say_en.note: Flags Ser/Thr candidates with local S/T fraction.

say_en.text: Mutate N297 to Q in the IgG1 Fc to remove glycosylation.
say_en.note: Substitutes Asn with Gln, returns mutated sequence.
